The patch only drops the `!!editMode &&` term from `isEditableSurface`. This relaxes the gate, so every edit-mode condition that held before still holds. The options and selection logic are untouched.

`canSelectCharts = canShowAlternatives && !insightDataLoading` is now enabled in view mode. The selection listener and the code that applies the display change are not shown, so I can't verify the selection path.

The remaining conditions are `!embedded && !inSharedMode && !isInDashboardContext && canEditInsight && !editingDisabledReason`. These still gate `isEditableSurface`, so embedded, dashboard, shared and no-permission surfaces stay hidden.

`canShowAlternatives` still requires `featureFlags[FEATURE_FLAGS.PRODUCT_ANALYTICS_CHART_ALTERNATIVES] && isEditableSurface && isTrends && !!query && !!trendsSource`. The patch does not touch these conditions.

The popover, `openGallery` and `closeGallery` UI is not shown. The listener only closes the gallery when `!canSelectCharts`, which is now true in view mode. The anchoring and popover rendering can't be verified.
